flavor.text: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon’s body returns to a pristine state overnight.
At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.
The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.
Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
